background engineering grid with dot fill

valve and gauge symbols on pipe
desktop and mobile artboards side by side
t2i_prompt: Dark navy web section showing <CONTENT> as a process flow: numbered outline boxes in monospace caps arranged in a serpentine two-column grid, each with a small P&ID-style glyph and tiny corner tags, joined by one double-line steel-blue pipe with soft glow, arrow-in-circle connectors, and inline valve and gauge symbols. Faint engineering grid with dot matrix behind. Title block top-left in mono caps. Beside it, a phone artboard with the same boxes stacked in a zigzag column and the pipe weaving through. Flat vector, square corners, one cool accent.
signature_idea: The treatment train is a real piping diagram whose boxes are the step cards.
strengths: reads like a document engineers already trust
weaknesses: all-mono caps is heavy and less readable
grid plus dots plus tags is busy
stage list includes heat exchanger/UV beyond the PP PW scope
brand_fit_why: Square boxes, navy, steel-blue pipe accent and mono figures fit; mono-only caps for everything replaces Geist light headlines and crowds the space.
